subject: prd/implement-now
statement: e2e tasks reach the executor through the unchanged frontier, claim, task, and charter path; no e2e-specific task type, required charter field, or second projection path is introduced, and plan-new and plangate are not edited — FR-28's origin reference is carried in the governing-document header the plan class already requires of every plan.
rationale: the upstream contract makes e2e tasks ordinary tracker tasks precisely so the executor consumes them unchanged; an e2e-specific schema would fork the planner and the projection it already owns, and an already-required field carries the signal without one
fit_criterion: the task and charter schemas and plan-new's pipeline are byte-unchanged; the e2e origin reference occupies an existing required plan header field and adds no new one; an e2e plan's tasks pass the existing frontier and claim mechanisms unmodified; a frontier mixing e2e and feature-implementation tasks dispatches through one path
